attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (GUI) x86-64 (stripped to external PDB), for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is a standard Tcl/Tk Windowing Shell interpreter (wish.exe). The file features legitimate imports from the Tcl and Tk libraries (e.g., Tcl_CreateInterp, Tk_MainExW) and follows the standard initialization sequence for such an application. Functional analysis of sub_140001450 confirms the setup of the Tcl interpreter and its configuration file (~/wishrc.tcl). While the sample uses VirtualProtect to set PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, this is a common characteristic of Mingw-w64 compiled binaries for managing pseudo-relocations during the runtime's initialization phase.
